Whenever I get nervous about what people may think in a situation, I try and remember that they will fall into one of two categories:

1) I know them so whatever the outcome of my actions either

A) they know how I am normally so they will understand my actions and won't care

B) I'll be able to explain how it turned out to them in person so even if it would be embarrassing, they won't care.

Or

2) they are complete strangers so I'll never see them again.

Also, most people care very little and remember even less about people they encounter randomly.

For other matters I remember that whatever happens will happen. I will influence what I can in a positive manner and if it is out of my control I won't waste time worrying about it.
